long_biography.plain_text:
Great Gulf began with a single lot in Cambridge, Ontario, and Elly Reisman helped turn the homebuilder into a broader North American property group. As chair and co-founder, he oversaw its move beyond residential construction into commercial and mixed-use development, construction management, engineered building systems, architecture and hospitality.

Reisman also sits on the board of Ashton Woods, the US homebuilder in which his family-related interests are among the private owners. Outside business, he endowed the George and Ruth Reisman Family Scholarships at the University of Toronto to support surgical trainees undertaking advanced research. The gift reflects his emphasis on patient, long-term investment in people and innovation.
